workUnit: SmartAIHub R5 SPEC-269 shared Project memory isolation

finding.baselineReproduction: At the baseline runtime SHA, the new persisted two-user case failed: user B, despite an active Project membership, received user A's private memory tagged with the shared Project.
finding.rootCause: searchGraphMemories ORed projectId/source relationship matches with the owner-scope filter, allowing relationship matches to bypass memory ownership.
finding.fix: Graph relationship conditions now execute inside buildScopeFilter's tenant and owner boundary.

database.name: miniapp_r5_test
database.schema: Curated R5 current-schema test projection; no historical full migration chain

reviewedSecurityLenses: Tenant predicate remains mandatory in buildScopeFilter
Owner type and owner ID scopes are applied before graph relationship matching
Project ID no longer forms an OR branch that can bypass ownership
Authorized shared Project rows remain retrievable through the canonical Project owner scope
Private user-owned Project memory is not visible to another Project member
Revoking the second user's current membership removes Project memory on the next prompt build
Global user memory remains available after Project membership revocation
Cross-tenant App-context mismatch still excludes Project scoped and entity memory
App-Project binding revocation remains denied by fresh receipt validation
Conversation retargeting to an unbound Project and NO_PROJECT remain Global-only
Structured and hybrid retrieval keep their existing owner-scope filter
Team-room promotion exclusion remains an AND constraint over graph results
Empty relationship conditions retain owner-scoped graph fallback behavior
Fixture cleanup constrains deletions to generated tenant/user/conversation identities
No schema migration, provider call, durable Project write, production ingress change, or protected dispatch
limitations: These are direct persisted acceptance cases, not completion of SPEC-269 T-01–T-23.
Authoritative App-private memory isolation remains open because the schema lacks an appId dimension.
Production ingress producer and deployed provenance remain unverified; test context is synthetic and server-side.
SPEC-271 WP2B worker restart/recovery and SPEC-302 durable Project writes remain unverified and fail-closed respectively.
